name: The Hall of Thanes
location: Ironforge (entrance at the High Seat), Dun Morogh
notes: Dwarven royal burial halls broken into by suspected Dark Iron dwarves. Easy access for Alliance; Horde must travel into Ironforge.

name: Ragefire Chasm
notes: Classic dungeon; level range retuned for Forever.

name: Ruins of Lordaeron
location: Ruins above the Undercity, Tirisfal Glades
notes: Scourge-haunted ruins with a necromancer (Rath'mael) as end boss. Easy Horde access; Alliance must cross Horde territory.

name: The Deadmines
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Wailing Caverns
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Shadowfang Keep
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
notes: Time-frozen titan area guarded by stray constructs and wildlife; Explorers' League interest. Final boss is level 31, so wiki suggests 26-32 in practice.

name: The Stockade
notes: Classic dungeon; level range raised for Forever.

name: City of Dalaran
location: Dalaran, Alterac Mountains (sewer grate on the west wall)
notes: Needs a Dalaran Sewer Key via attunement: Alliance 'An Alarming Request' (Emissary Jacques, Southshore); Horde 'Key to the City'/'Prison Break-In' (Magus Wordeen Voidglare, Tarren Mill).

name: Blackfathom Deeps
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Razorfen Kraul
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Gnomeregan
notes: Classic dungeon.

notes: Classic dungeon wing.

name: Scarlet Monastery: Library
notes: Classic dungeon wing.

name: The Drowned City
location: Off the Stranglethorn Vale coast west of Grom'gol; underwater entrance near The Vile Reef (approx. 21.4, 27.9)
notes: Risen sunken troll city with trolls, naga and a wrecked pirate ship; open-air, a storm rolls in before the final fight. Boss list is partial/preliminary.

name: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
notes: Classic dungeon wing.

name: Razorfen Downs
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
notes: Classic dungeon wing.

name: Krol'dok Stronghold
location: Riverglades, hill above Sunnyglade; cave entrance west of the fortress gates (approx. 37.5, 37.5)
notes: Ogre fortress whose outrunners kidnap travellers; Twilight's Hammer chanting at night. Early sources said 40-55 before a correction. Boss list partial.

name: Uldaman
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Zul'Farrak
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Alcaz Prison
location: Alcaz Island, Dustwallow Marsh (portal in a building basement, approx. 75, 15)
notes: Long-sealed prison where Defias Brotherhood and naga fight; rumours of King Varian Wrynn being held there (unconfirmed). Also called Alcaz Island Prison. Boss list partial.

name: Maraudon
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Temple of Atal'Hakkar (Sunken Temple)
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Blackrock Depths
notes: Classic dungeon; part of the Alliance Onyxia attunement chain.

name: Dire Maul: Warpwood Quarter (East)
notes: Classic dungeon wing.

name: Blackmaw Hold
location: Behind the furbolg gates in northern Azshara (tunnel at 38.7, 33.4; portal on Winterspring map at 66.6, 84.4)
notes: Furbolg city of the Blackmaw clan fighting a spreading corruption; deepest areas may lead further below Azeroth and it is one of the Barrow Deeps entrances. Blackmaw tribe reputation item (Blackmaw Pouch) datamined. Boss list partial.

name: Lower Blackrock Spire
notes: Classic dungeon; part of Horde Onyxia attunement.

name: Upper Blackrock Spire
notes: Classic dungeon; group size in Forever not confirmed by the sources read. Final steps of Onyxia attunement happen here.

name: Dire Maul: Capital Gardens (West)
notes: Classic dungeon wing.

name: Dire Maul: Gordok Commons (North)
notes: Classic dungeon wing.

name: Scholomance
notes: Classic dungeon.

name: Shaper's Terrace
location: Northern hills of Un'Goro Crater above Marshal's Refuge (approx. 48.1, 6.1)
notes: Ancient titan facility; Blue, Green, Red and Yellow Power Crystals gathered across Un'Goro are used at consoles inside. Boss list partial.

name: Stratholme
notes: Classic dungeon (Main Gate / Service Gate).

name: Barrow Deeps
location: Beneath Mount Hyjal; entrances via Mount Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold
notes: Illidan's former prison of the Watchers; night elf and corruption themes. 8 bosses.

name: Hyjal Summit
location: Summit of Mount Hyjal near Nordrassil
notes: 13 bosses; new tier sets and a legendary teased. Sources disagree on boss order and final boss (wiki: Nythus the Dreambound; Method: The Wild King).

name: Onyxia's Lair
notes: Only returning Classic raid at launch. Every member must carry the Drakefire Amulet (Alliance chain starts with 'Dragonkin Menace' in Burning Steppes; Horde with 'Blood and Thunder' in Badlands). Molten Core and other Classic raids not confirmed; one iconic raid is to be revamped in Summer 2027.

name: Darkspear Islands
location: Off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh; portals at Merchant Coast (Horde) and Northwatch (Alliance) plus battlemasters in capitals and the Barrens
notes: Eye of the Storm-style: four capture points plus a centre flag carried to owned bases; first to 2000 points wins. Reputation with Darkspear Raiders (Horde) or Theramore Expeditionary Force (Alliance) unlocks gear and a tabard at Exalted.

name: Warsong Gulch
notes: Returns at launch per Timesaver; Forever size/brackets not stated (Classic was 10v10).

name: Arathi Basin
notes: Returns at launch per Timesaver; Forever size/brackets not stated (Classic was 15v15).

name: Alterac Valley
notes: Returns at launch per Timesaver (it was absent from the beta); Forever size/brackets not stated (Classic was 40v40).

name: Battle for Gilneas
notes: Listed as 'new in Forever' only by a client-data site (metabot.gg); not confirmed by Blizzard or the wiki - treat as unconfirmed/datamined.
